public_boundary.registration: explicit caller-side registration only; no installed registry entry

invariants: Task-local optional reference only: no shared SDK source, public API, ABI, descriptor, registry default or installed behavior is modified.
Fixed v0 format: 16 kHz, mono f32, 160-sample frames. The explicit centre frequency and bandwidth are caller controls, not registry defaults.
The C provider is off by default; OFF leaves it unlinked and unregistered, ON requires explicit caller-side registration on one registry.
Frozen external-provider settings must stay empty; the explicit control is carried by the caller-local provider ID at the public boundary.
Missing, malformed, nonfinite, out-of-range or inconsistent controls fail explicitly; no missing result qualifies a candidate.
Synthetic formant speech, sweeps, steps, impulses, silence, load and loop controls are not real speech, listening, device or release evidence.
Canonical reports and f32 output digests are exact and reproducible from the pinned deterministic fixture.
release_gates: Authorized real-speech corpus with clean references and a blinded intelligibility/quality protocol
Measured loudspeaker/microphone loop with pinned gain, delay and nonlinear saturation
Target-device CPU, memory, deadline and availability measurement
Provider intake, rights, license, descriptor and public catalog review before any default or installed provider
